heading: Today
text: Valley fog burning off to sunshine, mixing with some clouds south and east.  Highs ranging through the 60s.  Winds light, becoming north to northeast up to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear in the St. Lawrence and NY, with some high clouds through VT, and increasing periods of clouds in southern NH.  Lows in the mid 30s to mid 40s, coolest in the north.  Winds diminishing to light and variable, remaining north near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny in the St. Lawrence and NY, mixing with high clouds.  Some sun through VT, giving way to high clouds, and clouds thickening through NH into eastern VT.  Highs in the 60s to near 70.  Winds becoming north to northeast 10 to 15 mph.
